how: Bay Padel runs indoor padel and pickleball courts on Treasure Island with online court reservations; Park Padel also ran public courts at Embarcadero Plaza.
San Francisco GAA runs Gaelic football, hurling and camogie clubs (Na Fianna, Pearse Og, St. Joseph's, Eire Og) playing at Pairc na nGael on Treasure Island.
The Golden Gate Australian Football League fields the Roos (men) and Iron Maidens (women), training in San Francisco, Oakland and Palo Alto, with non-contact intro sessions for beginners.
One-hour custom perfume blending classes (30 essential oils, bottle to take home) are listed at 405 Sansome St, with other fragrance workshops at hotels and studios.
City College of San Francisco Extension teaches a Saturday Seasonal Ikebana class at Ocean Campus, and Ikebana International Chapter 31 holds monthly demonstrations.
venue: City College of San Francisco Extension (Ocean Campus)

how: Richmond Art Center offers beginner drypoint and solar etching classes with an etching press, and CCA runs etching and electro-etching print courses at its San Francisco campus.
Sandbox VR has a downtown location with four full-body-tracking VR rooms for group games, and Immersive Gamebox operates at Stonestown Galleria.
San Francisco Beekeepers Association (est. 1976) meets monthly at the Randall Museum, and members teach beginner beekeeping classes at Garden for the Environment.
The SF SPCA recruits adult volunteers (info session, six-month commitment) for dog walking, cat socialising, fostering and mobile vaccine clinics.
Richmond Art Center has offered tapestry and frame-loom weaving classes, though no currently scheduled session was confirmed.
The Scotch Malt Whisky Society hosts San Francisco member and guest tastings (e.g. at Elixir in the Mission), and the St. Andrew's Society runs Whisky Wednesdays tastings.
venue: Scotch Malt Whisky Society tastings at Elixir

how: Fifth Taste Sake School runs WSET and Sake Sommelier Association courses in Berkeley and Emeryville, and two-hour Sake 101 tasting classes are listed on Cortland Avenue.
Preserved Goods in Oakland teaches two-hour kombucha classes with all supplies provided, and SF Public Library and 18 Reasons have run kombucha and SCOBY workshops.
Pacific Hackers and DevSecCon SF Bay Area run CTF events and beginner CTF sessions, but they are occasional rather than a standing weekly venue.
Origami Palooza is an annual Japantown festival with free folding and paid master classes, and SF Public Library holds origami sessions; no standing weekly class was confirmed.

Horological Society of New York's Horology 101-103 courses have been taught in San Francisco at Shreve & Co., and Worn & Wound x DIY Watch Club ran a build-your-own-watch class at Fort Mason; both are occasional.
San Francisco Pacific Philatelic Society meets monthly at the San Francisco Main Library, and Golden Gate Stamp Club meets twice monthly.

Nava Dance Theatre has run all-levels drop-in Bharatanatyam classes at Dance Mission Theatre in San Francisco and at Shawl Anderson Dance Center in Berkeley, and several academies teach on the Peninsula.
LionDanceME trains and performs lion dance from a Chinatown studio and Portsmouth Square, with lion dance clubs at five city high schools.
Beginner coffee roasting workshops (about 90 minutes, take home your own roast) are listed on a Marin County patio, and Sightglass runs brewing classes in SoMa.
venue: Bay Area coffee roasting class (Marin County)

how: Gamelan Sekar Jaya runs Balinese gong kebyar music and dance classes at its banjar community centre on Shattuck Avenue in Berkeley, with beginner series and drop-ins on a sliding scale.
Maddie's Pet Adoption Center at the SF SPCA Mission campus offers walk-in, same-day cat and dog adoptions for adults with photo ID and proof of address.
Kabuki Springs & Spa offers Eastern, Swedish and prenatal massage alongside its Japanese-inspired bathhouse.
Kabuki Springs & Spa describes a Japanese-style bathhouse with natural thermal spring soaking in the city; the natural springs of Calistoga and Sonoma are well beyond 30 km.
Rowboats and pedal boats can be rented at the boathouse on Stow Lake (Blue Heron Lake) in Golden Gate Park.

Golden Gate Angling & Casting Club is based at Anglers Lodge and its fly casting pools in Golden Gate Park, which are still in use; actual freshwater fishing is mostly in lakes and reservoirs around the Bay.
venue: Golden Gate Angling & Casting Club (Anglers Lodge)

how: The Oceanic Society, founded in San Francisco, runs naturalist-led whale watching trips for gray, humpback and blue whales, with a gray whale migration season from winter into spring.
SF Parkour has listed free monthly beginner 'Urban Ninja' sessions with rotating locations including the Embarcadero and UC Berkeley, but no dedicated gym in the city was confirmed.
San Francisco Zen Center's City Center is an urban temple offering zazen practice, beginner resources and a calendar of classes and retreats.
No accessible glaciers exist in the Bay Area; the nearest guided glacier trekking is in Washington's Cascades or Alaska, a flight away.
No suitable active volcano exists nearby; volcano boarding is done on Cerro Negro in Nicaragua.
Dog sledding needs reliable snow; the nearest operators are around Lake Tahoe, roughly 3.5 hours' drive from San Francisco.
No snow in the Bay Area; the nearest ski resorts are at Lake Tahoe, roughly 3.5 to 4 hours' drive away.
No desert dunes in the metro area; the nearest sandboarding is at Oceano Dunes about 4 hours' drive south, or desert dunes in Southern California.
No rafting rivers within 30 km; the nearest commercial white water rafting is on the American River near Coloma, roughly 2 to 2.5 hours' drive.
No luge or bobsled track in Northern California; nearest dedicated tracks are in Park City, Utah, or Lake Placid, New York.

how: Cheese rolling is a one-off annual event at Cooper's Hill in Gloucestershire, England.
Buzkashi is a Central Asian horseback game played mainly in Afghanistan; no Bay Area venue exists.
Canyoning needs slot canyons with flowing water, which the Bay Area lacks; the nearest guided canyoning is in the Sierra Nevada foothills, around 3 hours' drive.
